title: Public website builder, preview fence, and production release denial
summary: The nine-page cream/wattle preview remains candidate-only. The v0.4.1 corrective candidate always marks preview noindex and denies production until a real authenticated CMS/Brand/Wire release-receipt verifier exists.
invariants: Pages: Home, Alchemy Project, Visualisation, Audio Analysis, Video Analysis, Secure Protocol, Intelligent Software, Enquiries and Privacy.
Public source is not a live CMS Brand/Wire publication; Wire resource receipts cannot be inferred from source SHA-256.
The apex public TLS must not require a private Office/NOC client certificate or forward into their route trees.
The HTTPS v0.4.7 library candidate is source-hash-verified, but acceptance and SNI/vhost live qualification are outstanding.
No Nginx, Apache or external CMS fallback is a substitute for native implementation.
Content digest and local approved_by/approved_at fields are not authentic release authorisation; fail closed until external CMS/Brand/Wire receipts are verified.
Preview renders noindex,nofollow for every page, including an editorial record marked approved; robots.txt disallows indexing.
Website Publisher v0.3 is a separate offline-to-ooRexx editorial candidate handoff, not an authenticated publishing service.

provenance.claim: Editable source adoption, preview tests and publication gates.
